description: MainActivity.kt defines an Android activity responsible for rendering a two-player Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, updating UI components, and integrating with an AI-based trash talk feature. It handles user interactions, maintains game persistence across configuration changes, and ties UI elements to game logic and external API calls.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the UI and interactions for a Tic Tac Toe game, including game state management, UI updates, and external API integration for trash talk generation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores game state if available, sets up event listeners, and prepares the game engine.

methods.name: wireUpBoard
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to each game board cell to handle user moves.

methods.name: updateUIFromEngine
methods.description: Updates UI components based on current game state, including the game board, scoreboard, and status messages.

methods.name: buildBoardAscii
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the current game board for use in prompts to the AI.

methods.name: requestTrashTalk
methods.description: Launches a background thread to request a trash talk message from the AI and displays it.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves layout resource IDs by name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves view ID resources by name.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Persists current game state and icon selections across configuration changes.
